name: ldbc_mix_reads
title: LDBC Interactive, LDBC frequencies, reads only (I01 without its updates)
method: I01's complex reads IC1-IC12 and short reads IS1-IS7, at I01's counts (per 100,000 updates of I01); the updates IU1-IU8 are left out. LDBC ships no read-only mix: this is its own read mix, as L02 is LinkBench's. The short-read rate is an upper bound, as in I01.
expect: The same two ends as I01: All-Chunked cheapest in ops, Split/Condensed in bytes (reads are 95% of I01's bytes in Split/Condensed). At the ends the best mixed layout gains at most 2% in either currency: I01's 4% bytes gain came from two write lists, which I02 does not write. Within the reference layout's bytes (B = 1) a mix still pays, about as much as on I01 (3.5x fewer ops than the best single layout that fits, at SF30): the budget picks which read lists to chunk.
